register.proposition: Ione Berrick and Emmett Vann may be considered for discretionary distributions. The trustees exercise discretion over income and capital jointly. An Object has no entitlement before an appointment in that Object’s favour.
register.reporter: Tess Arnay, deed-records clerk, in m4v7.
register.effective_date: Deed dated 21 October 2022; position assessed at the cut-off.
register.receipt_by_cutoff: Selected-clause extract certified 9 June 2026 and in the closed file; schedule omitted.
competing_passages: h6q3 makes an addition only, not a removal; r5n8 does not resolve whether the addition was to this settlement.
register.reason: The existing objects remain unless separately removed by deed. No separate removal appears in the file.

register.proposition: An existing payment authorisation for this settlement can be identified and used for payment.
register.origin: An operative trustee decision or appointment would be needed; none is supplied.
register.reporter: Maren Dovell requests decision references in j8f2; no decision-maker’s payment authorisation is reported.
register.effective_date: No decision or payment date established.
register.receipt_by_cutoff: No recorded payment authorisation for Alder Quay is in the closed file.
competing_passages: j8f2 expressly authorises no payment.
h6q3 neither appoints property nor directs payment.
t3w6 records an office reimbursement, not a trust distribution.
register.reason: There is no payment to list as already authorised from this file. That does not establish that no decision exists elsewhere.

register.proposition: Ione Berrick and Orla Penrick may be considered for discretionary distributions. The trustees act together over income and capital and may apply funds directly for an Object’s benefit. Eligibility alone confers no right to payment.
register.reporter: Bram Lerrit, deed-records clerk, in x2c9.
register.effective_date: Deed dated 21 October 2022; position assessed at the cut-off.
register.receipt_by_cutoff: Extract certified 9 June 2026 and in the closed file; schedules omitted.
competing_passages: h6q3 makes an addition only, not a removal; r5n8 does not resolve whether the addition was to this settlement.
register.reason: The existing Objects remain unless separately removed by deed. No separate removal appears in the file.

register.proposition: An existing payment authorisation for this settlement can be identified and used for payment.
register.origin: An operative trustee decision under this settlement’s deed would be needed; none is supplied.
register.reporter: Maren Dovell requests a separate check in j8f2; no decision-maker’s payment authorisation is reported.
register.effective_date: No decision or payment date established.
register.receipt_by_cutoff: No recorded payment authorisation for Flint Orchard is in the closed file.
competing_passages: j8f2 expressly authorises no payment.
h6q3 neither appoints property nor directs payment.
t3w6 records an office reimbursement, not a trust distribution.
register.reason: The direct-application power is not itself a decision to apply funds. There is no payment to list as already authorised from this file.

register.proposition: Ellis Harnett is the Alder Quay settlor; Cora Teague is the Flint Orchard settlor. Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell were original trustees of both and are reported currently in office for both.
register.origin: The separate lodged deeds for the settlors and original trustees; the appointments book for current office.
register.reporter: Tess Arnay in m4v7, Bram Lerrit in x2c9, and Meeting Secretary Maren Dovell in j8f2.
register.effective_date: Deeds dated 21 October 2022; current office as reported for the 12 June 2026 cut-off.
register.receipt_by_cutoff: Both extracts and the meeting note are in the closed file.
competing_passages: h6q3 and r5n8 identify the same signatories and delivering parties, but neither establishes current office for a named settlement.
register.reason: Original appointments and current office agree, but have different proof. The shared trustees and meeting slot do not merge the settlements or their decisions.

register.proposition: Both deeds permit the serving trustees acting together to add a named living individual, other than the settlor or a serving trustee, by deed without outside consent. Joint delivery is operative. The common custody procedure permits identification by the lodged parent deed reference linked to the instrument reference, without the settlement name in the designation. Both deeds apply the law of England and Wales.
register.origin: Alder Quay clauses 6 and 9; Flint Orchard clauses 8 and 12.
register.reporter: Tess Arnay in m4v7 and Bram Lerrit in x2c9.
register.effective_date: Deeds dated 21 October 2022; an addition takes effect on joint delivery.
register.receipt_by_cutoff: Both certified extracts are in the closed file.
competing_passages: h6q3 leaves the parent deed to be identified at delivery; r5n8 records the handover but does not reproduce a complete parent reference.
register.reason: Omitting the settlement name does not by itself invalidate a designation under this procedure. Custody records memorialise delivery; they do not themselves designate a person.

register.proposition: The signed designation identifies Rhea Marden as a living individual and designates her as an additional discretionary Object under the one parent deed for which it is jointly delivered. Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell signed as a deed, each witnessed in person by Della Pennick.
register.origin: Signed paper SD-Q7M2 and its attestations.
register.reporter: Alys Morcant, signing-room clerk, certified the transcript in h6q3; Della Pennick is the attesting witness.
register.effective_date: Transcript checked before handover on 26 March 2026; the designation says it takes effect on joint delivery, not on signature alone.
register.receipt_by_cutoff: The checked transcript is in the closed file.
competing_passages: The certificate in h6q3 expressly does not attest to delivery.
r5n8 separately reports the handover.
register.reason: The transcript proves what was signed. It neither names the settlement nor proves delivery on its own.

register.proposition: Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell jointly released one signed original for immediate delivery as a deed, not in escrow, and confirmed a parent deed reference against the instrument reference at handover.
register.origin: The handover and contemporaneous Merefold live custody register entry.
register.reporter: Gideon Sarn, Custody Officer, in r5n8.
register.effective_date: 11:30 GMT on 26 March 2026; the original was placed in the common deed vault that day.
register.receipt_by_cutoff: Single-entry extract certified 11 June 2026 and in the closed file; the parent field is reproduced only as PD-68?4-R.
competing_passages: h6q3 expressly does not certify delivery; that limitation is not a denial that delivery occurred.
register.reason: The entry reports what both trustees did at handover, not a later inference from a trust title or beneficiary file. It does not certify the unreadable character.

register.origin: Designation h6q3, delivery record r5n8, and the Alder Quay delivery power and full reference in m4v7.
register.reporter: Alys Morcant, Gideon Sarn and Tess Arnay report the separate components.
register.effective_date: 11:30 GMT on 26 March 2026 if PD-6834-R was the reference jointly identified.
register.receipt_by_cutoff: All component records are in the closed file, but no readable full parent reference for this handover was received.
competing_passages: x2c9 gives PD-6894-R for Flint Orchard Settlement; that reference also fits PD-68?4-R.
register.reason: If the missing character is 3, the documented designation and handover point to Alder Quay, not Flint Orchard. The cut-off copy does not establish 3. Withhold this edge.

register.origin: Designation h6q3, delivery record r5n8, and the Flint Orchard delivery power and full reference in x2c9.
register.reporter: Alys Morcant, Gideon Sarn and Bram Lerrit report the separate components.
register.effective_date: 11:30 GMT on 26 March 2026 if PD-6894-R was the reference jointly identified.
register.receipt_by_cutoff: All component records are in the closed file, but no readable full parent reference for this handover was received.

register.reason: If the missing character is 9, the documented designation and handover point to Flint Orchard, not Alder Quay. The cut-off copy does not establish 9. Withhold this edge.

register.scope: Limits of the designation and meeting papers
register.proposition: The same SD-Q7M2 handover added Rhea Marden to both settlements, or the designation or meeting note itself authorised payment.
register.origin: Tested against the operative text of SD-Q7M2, the custody entry and the preparation note.
register.reporter: Alys Morcant in h6q3, Gideon Sarn in r5n8 and Maren Dovell in j8f2.
register.effective_date: 26 March 2026 for the handover; 12 June 2026 for the note.
register.receipt_by_cutoff: All three sources are in the closed file.
competing_passages: h6q3 refers to the singular parent deed and expressly makes an addition only.
r5n8 records one original, not a counterpart series, and says the shared-stock instrument reference carries no trust or sequence information.
j8f2 says the note authorises no payment.
register.reason: The two named readings are alternatives for one delivery, not two additions. Neither the designation nor the note is a payment decision.

register.proposition: As of her letter, the replacement travel estimate had not arrived and Ione Berrick said the old one was no longer reliable. She permits Sella Quist to pass on the new estimate and offers to sign confirmations herself.
register.effective_date: 18 February; year not printed in the letter.
register.receipt_by_cutoff: The letter is in the closed file. Receipt of a replacement estimate by the cut-off is not established.
competing_passages: t3w6 concerns the costs of forwarding papers, not receipt or verification of a replacement estimate.
register.reason: The letter reports the position on its date and grants narrow permission to forward paperwork. It does not confer general authority to act for Ione Berrick.

register.proposition: Sella Quist is eligible in her own right under either settlement, or holds broader representative authority.
register.origin: Ione Berrick’s request that Sella Quist be considered in her own right and the EX-K4 remit entry.
register.reporter: Ione Berrick in b9k4 and Una Cresset in t3w6.
register.effective_date: Letter dated 18 February; reconciliation dated 11 June.
register.receipt_by_cutoff: Letter and reconciliation are in the closed file; no designation or wider mandate for Sella Quist is supplied.
competing_passages: b9k4 asks whether the trustees can help and says Ione Berrick does not know what either deed allows.
t3w6 limits the payee and queries-contact entry to EX-K4.
register.reason: Neither a request for consideration nor an expense entry establishes beneficiary status or broader authority. Do not add a Sella Quist edge to either settlement.

register.scope: Payments requested in Ione Berrick’s letter
register.proposition: Ione Berrick requested a standing payment, diversion of a payment intended for her to Sella Quist, or a deduction from her own payment.
register.effective_date: 18 February; year not printed in the letter.
competing_passages: b9k4 expressly disclaims all three requests and treats incidental expenses separately.
t3w6 identifies Sella Quist as payee and queries contact for EX-K4 only.
register.reason: The request was for consideration of Sella Quist in her own right, not a payment instruction or an assignment of any benefit.

register.proposition: Sella Quist was reimbursed £12.60 for postage from the office operating account; the item was not recharged.
register.origin: The attached postage slip, EX-K4 claim and matched office operating-account line.
register.reporter: Una Cresset, Accounts Administrator, in t3w6.
register.effective_date: Reimbursement matched on 5 June; reconciliation dated 11 June.
register.receipt_by_cutoff: The reconciliation is in the closed file and reports that the slip was attached.
competing_passages: b9k4 asks for incidental expenses to be accounted for separately; t3w6 reports no distribution instruction for this claim.
register.reason: This was a paid office expense. It is not an authorised distribution from either settlement, and the matching date is not stated to be the payment date.

register.proposition: The £8.40 print-shop claim is a paid or authorised balance.
register.origin: The EX-K4 expense list and reconciliation.
register.effective_date: Status reported in the 11 June reconciliation.
register.receipt_by_cutoff: The reconciliation is in the closed file; the office never received the receipt and holds no copy or substitute voucher.
competing_passages: The expense list refers to a receipt, but t3w6 expressly records non-receipt, no payment, no authorised balance and no recharge.
register.reason: The underlying expense remains a separate, unresolved finance query. A reference to a receipt is not evidence that it arrived.

register.proposition: One slot was booked for 17 June with Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell, but Alder Quay must have the first separate paper and minute entry and Flint Orchard the second. Late papers are to go to the meeting separately, not into the closed preparation set.
register.origin: The meeting secretary’s preparation directions and booking.
register.effective_date: Preparation note dated 12 June 2026; cut-off 16:00 BST that day.
register.reason: The shared slot is an administrative arrangement, not a joint settlement decision or a payment authority.

source_audit.limits: The appointments-book report, not the booking, supports current office. The preparation note reports no operative distribution decision and authorises no payment.
source_audit.scoring_note: For benchmark_v2_evidence_v1, each of the ten positive edges has standalone quotation and attribution in its attached alternative; none requires multiple Sources or has ordinary evidence marked N/A. For attached_sufficient_set_v1, each complete set is attached to its own edge. The unresolved Rhea Marden readings are not positive edges.

source_audit.limits: Certified copy of selected provisions of PD-6834-R, not a second deed or evidence of a payment appointment. It identifies the original trustees, not independently the current trustees. Its full reference fits one reading of r5n8, but the extract does not link SD-Q7M2 to this deed.

Certified copy of provisions of the separate deed PD-6894-R, not a duplicate of m4v7 or evidence of a payment decision. It identifies original, not independently current, trustees. Its full reference fits the other reading of r5n8, but does not link SD-Q7M2 to this deed.

Checked copy of the signed designation and attestations. It supplies Rhea Marden’s identity and the conditional addition, but no named parent deed, independent proof of delivery, removal or payment authority.

Certified copy of one custody register entry. It concerns the same paper as h6q3 but has a separate origin in the observed handover. The two reports are complementary, not duplicate proof. The entry does not name the additional Object or resolve the unreadable parent character.

First-person report and request. Neither addressing the two trustees nor discussing help for Ione Berrick or Sella Quist independently links a named person to a named settlement under a scored predicate.

Accounts reconciliation, not a trustee appointment, beneficiary designation or distribution instruction. No source establishes a parent, sibling or spouse edge; mentions of assistance, joint administration, signatures or a common meeting do not establish family relationships.

questions: Alder Quay Settlement: Can the adviser check the full lodged deed PD-6834-R, including the omitted schedule and any later instruments, before confirming who may be considered? Can the trustees reconcile its own minutes, appointments or decisions and payment records and cite the operative decision for each payment actually authorised?
Flint Orchard Settlement: Can the adviser make the same checks independently against PD-6894-R and its own records, including any decision to apply funds directly for an Object’s benefit?

SD-Q7M2: Can Merefold provide a legible certified parent reference from the contemporaneous entry or handover record, verified against SD-Q7M2 and the joint confirmations? Do not select a reference from the shared trustees, the instrument label, or the two compatible deed references. Keep any material received after the cut-off separate for the meeting.

Ione Berrick and Sella Quist: Has the replacement estimate arrived, and should Ione Berrick confirm it personally? If the trustees wish to consider Sella Quist in her own right, what authority, if any, exists under each deed? Do not use the forwarding permission or EX-K4 as that authority.

Ordinary finance, separate from both papers: Can Una Cresset obtain the £8.40 print-shop receipt or an acceptable substitute voucher? Keep it as an unpaid, unauthorised query and retain the matched £12.60 postage reimbursement as a distinct office-account item.
